references.author: Prozzi, Jorge A. and Hong, Feng
references.title: Average Treatment Effect for Modeling Maintenance Work
references.role_in_review: Closest road-domain selection/timing causal analysis; not a reproduced estimator.
references.reading_scope: Methods, data, empirical results and conclusions read from the user-supplied final article; key equation/DAG page also inspected visually. Bibliographic metadata checked against publisher.

claims.claim: Population ATE, treated and untreated subpopulation effects; conditional mean ignorability on existing surface/base/subbase thickness and accumulated log ESAL.
claims.limits: A controlled AASHO design argument, not certified for every LTPP experiment.

claims.claim: OLS model adds treatment times centered-covariate interactions; case is approximately three-inch AASHO overlays and PSI, with treatment triggered by PSI below1.5.
claims.limits: No shared-data numerical reproduction here; own rut-depth targets differ.

references.author: You, Lingyun and Guo, Nanning and Long, Zhengwu and Wang, Fusong and Si, Chundi and Diab, Aboelkasim
references.title: Appraising annual post-maintenance functional performance of asphalt roadway based on causal inference approach
references.role_in_review: Closest road-domain structural/potential-outcome maintenance evaluation; no inferred full-text implementation.
references.reading_scope: Methods, data, empirical results and conclusions read from the user-supplied final article; key equation/DAG page also inspected visually. Bibliographic metadata checked against publisher.

claims.claim: SPS-3 four preventive treatments versus untreated, annual low-severity longitudinal wheel-path cracking over five years; matching uses temperature, freezing index and cumulative ESAL.
claims.locator: doc:76159ad/tier:flash/page:6-8; printed pp.5-7, Sections3.1-3.2 and Fig.3
claims.limits: Endpoint, trial and exposure clock differ from SPS-10 and Manitoba SPS-5.

claims.claim: Logistic generalized additive propensity model, one-to-one nearest matching with replacement, balance statistics/score distributions; the article acknowledges some remaining imbalance.
claims.locator: doc:76159ad/tier:flash/page:8-10; printed pp.7-9, Eq.8 and Tables1-4
claims.limits: Balance of measured covariates does not by itself demonstrate exchangeability or validate the present physical-section transfer.

claims.claim: Pretreatment condition is excluded partly on the stated assumption that it does not determine treatment; unavailable precipitation/moisture is acknowledged.
claims.limits: This is a study-specific assumption; its exclusion is not transported to Manitoba where original patch-dependent placement is documented.
